note: page -> gold confidence label for the LWM_034 deterministic confidence scorer, labelled against the synthetic gold wiki built by llm_wiki.eval.contradiction_baseline.build_contradiction_gold_wiki. Gold labels encode the intended signal profile: 3 resolvable recent sources -> high; 2 sources (one unresolvable) older -> medium; 1 unresolvable source, stale -> low; no sources/updated -> low (never high). Disjoint tune/gate; gate is the fail-on-drop accuracy metric (ADR-0022).
